title: A Phase 3 Open-Label Study of Long-term Treatment With Povetacicept in Adults With Immunoglobulin A Nephropathy
official: A Phase 3, Single-Arm, Open-Label Extension Study Evaluating the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Povetacicept in Adults With Immunoglobulin A Nephropathy
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of povetacicept in subjects with immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN)

interventions.name: ALPN-303 Solution for Injection in Pre-filled Pen

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Subject will sign and date an informed consent form (ICF).
2. 2. Willing and able to comply with scheduled visits, treatment plan, study restrictions, laboratory tests, contraceptive guidelines, and other study procedures.
3. 3. Did not withdraw consent from the parent study.
4. 4. Completed the treatment period of the parent study and has not permanently discontinued study drug
5. 5. eGFR ≥15 mL/min/1.73 m2 within 45 days of Day 1 of this study (repeat measurements  allowed within this window).
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Pregnant or breastfeeding at the time of consent on Day 1 or planning to become pregnant ≤12 weeks following the last dose of study drug.
2. 2. Planned participation in another interventional, therapeutic clinical trial (other than the parent study).
3. 3. Any condition or circumstances which in the opinion of the investigator or Vertex may make a subject unlikely or unable to complete the study or comply with study procedures and requirements.
4. 4. Subjects committed to an institution by virtue of an order issued either by the judicial or the administrative authorities or who are in a dependent relationship with the Vertex or the investigator.
